newsitem.title: USA: Nebraska fed cattle market quiet, no trade-private.
newsitem.headline: Nebraska fed cattle market quiet, no trade-private.

text.p: Nebraska feedlot cattle markets near midday Friday were quiet, with no sales reported, market sources there said.
The bulk of this week's sales were at $110.00 per cwt on a dressed basis, down $1.00 from most of last week's trade, with a few at $109.00 on Thursday.
On a live basis, sales were mostly at $68.00 this week, steady with last week, with a few at $67.00 on Thursday.
Weekly sales totaled 64,600 head, including 5,800 formulated and previously contracted cattle, USDA reported. This week's showlist had been estimated near 68,000 head.
